capabilityDomains.name: Incident assessment and customer impact
capabilityDomains.summary: Establish what is broken, who is affected, and how severe the impact is before narrowing the investigation.

capabilityDomains.name: Incident management process
capabilityDomains.summary: Use the Sev1 out-of-hours model: record, communicate, bridge, and hand over without treating the ticket as a solo puzzle.

capabilityDomains.name: Microsoft engagement
capabilityDomains.summary: Know when a Microsoft support case or service-health dependency is appropriate, and what evidence to prepare.

capabilityDomains.name: Azure and AVD technical understanding and investigation
capabilityDomains.summary: Interpret host pool, gateway, session host, and control-plane evidence in a safe order.

capabilityDomains.name: Networking and dependency troubleshooting
capabilityDomains.summary: Consider DNS, routing, Secure Access / Prisma, firewalls, and name resolution as first-class fault domains.

capabilityDomains.name: Documentation and runbook usage
capabilityDomains.summary: Use approved runbooks and known-error information rather than improvising from memory.

capabilityDomains.name: Escalation and support model awareness
capabilityDomains.summary: Involve Major Incident Management, senior engineers, identity, networking, or application teams at the right time.

capabilityDomains.name: Communication and stakeholder updates
capabilityDomains.summary: Give timely, factual updates and confirm recovery with users rather than assuming a green portal means service is restored.

readinessCriteria.notes: A high domain average must not hide an unmet mandatory criterion. Completion of attempts is not readiness.
